text:
maria: Heads up — PR #4123 (render-cache refactor) is blocked by CI. Failing intermittent test: RenderCacheTest::timeSensitive on job `unit-render-cache-4`. Local rerun sometimes passes.
ci-bot: buildkite job failed — job: unit-render-cache-4, test: RenderCacheTest::timeSensitive. Logs: https://buildkite.company/teams/redwood/pipelines/renderer/builds/12345 — stacktrace attached.
jen: I saw that earlier. Looks time-dependent; the test reads `SystemClock.now()` + small sleep. @sam did your change touch any clock or timing loops?
sam: I refactored cache eviction logic but didn’t change the clock mocks intentionally. I did add a micro-wait (`sleep(0.05)`) to debounce. Repro command I used locally:
```
pytest tests/render/test_cache.py::RenderCacheTest::test_time_sensitive -q
```
alex: Can we do a targeted rerun? If it's just one shard flake we can rerun and approve if it stays green. Maria, want me to trigger rerun?
maria: Yes please run a targeted rerun on the failing shard first. If it passes twice, I'll consider approving and doing a small snapshot update for the expectation delta.
buildkite-bot: Re-run requested by alex — targeted-rerun on shard 4 queued (build 5678).
ci-bot: build 5678 finished ✅ — all tests passed on that run (shard 4 green).
jen: Two green runs are a decent signal but one failure earlier worries me. Alex, can you run it one more time? I'll triage the test after.
alex: Kicked off another targeted rerun — queued.
buildkite-bot: Re-run finished — build 5690. Result: ❌ one test failed: RenderCacheTest::timeSensitive. Failure excerpt:
```
AssertionError: expected cache expiry <= 100ms, got 150ms
  at tests/render/test_cache.py:78
```
sam: That lines up with a timing skew — the added debounce can push the window. I can make the test deterministic by mocking time in a follow-up PR. For unblock, options: snapshot/expectation update, add small guard allowing variance, or temporary ignore.
maria: I prefer not to ignore. For immediate unblock I'm willing to approve if we add a tolerant guard in the test and create a follow-up issue to harden it. @alex can you approve with that condition?
alex: I can approve with the guard: add `assert_elapsed <= 120ms or log_warning('timing variance')` and a TODO linking an issue to remove the guard. Approving now with that note. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks — I'll merge after CI stabilizes on the next green. I'll open the follow-up issue assigned to @sam to replace sleeps with a mocked clock and tighten the assertion.
sam: Ack — will open issue and link the branch/PR for the deterministic fix.
